_about: SC-level truth for ACT pages. An ACT label says whether the page passes the ACT rule under test; InterA11y is scored on whether the page fails the SC. These pages pass (or are inapplicable to) their rule but contain a definite failure of the same SC elsewhere, found by a blind audit of all 202 non-violating ACT test pages (page copies without titles, rule ids or tool outputs; 2026-09-29) and verified by hand. Applied to every system alike, in the SC-level variants only; raw-label metrics are unchanged. Audit verdicts not applied: 5c01ea/b7736b7d (aria-expanded="undefined" is a valid ARIA value), akn7bn/63cd20ec (1x1 iframe, borderline), 307n5z/e687f56e (focusable span in a link, a judgement call); 14 uncertain verdicts (author intent: decorative graphics, frame-name equivalence, glyph contrast).

674b10/0b8e3a6fb2bfd495683f686cf99ea1e46.reason: An empty role falls back to textbox; the textbox has no label, so its accessible name is empty.

e086e5/09ea6ee13f7f26b0d6e3103946209ea07.reason: role=checkbox without aria-checked, a state ARIA 1.2 requires: the checkbox's state is not exposed.

c487ae/bd0d0d0cda19a4d58dfe311cd7c8de340.reason: A focusable link hidden from assistive technology: focus lands on a control with no name or role exposed (F107-type).

80af7b/d2f5325f3fd5ddde38cd677a5ca36ba0d.reason: Blur handlers return focus between Button1 and Button2, so focus cannot stay on Button3 or leave; no exit is described.

4b1c6c/21d4d4b931e9f06b5c4a008cb1989aa19.reason: The outer iframe has no accessible name (ACT cae760's requirement).

4b1c6c/8f35b76114d0dd59fcd78d46c7af11383.reason: Neither iframe has an accessible name (ACT cae760's requirement).
